main_text.head: CONCLVSIONES PRO HAERETICIS damnatæ.
main_text.p: 1SVBSTANTIA PANIS MATERIALIS & uini manet post consecrationem in sacramento altaris.
2Accidentia non manent sine subiecto in eodem sacramento post consecrationem.
3Quod Christus non sit in sacramento altaris identicè, uerè, & realiter in propria persona corporali.
4Quod si episcopus uel sacerdos sit in peccato mortali non ordinat, conficit, nec baptisat.
5Quod si homo fuerit debitè contritus, omnis confessio exterior est sibi superflua & inutilis.

page.notes: Page is a printed page of Siasticae (Lib. I), p. 28. The sixth thesis breaks off at the foot of the page; the catchword is not legible as printed. Signature "D iiij" reads as D iiij at the foot.
